stories.title: Ontario Liberals to name new leader after weeks of voting
stories.summary: The favourites are said to be caucus member and former hospital president Lee Fairclough, and former Liberal cabinet minister and Rogers Communications executive Navdeep Bains.

stories.title: Boy, 14, pleads guilty in stabbing death of retired nurse
stories.summary: Assistant Crown attorney Andrea McPhedran told Ontario Court Justice Rachel Grinberg that it is aggravating that an innocent stranger was killed as she was going about her day.

stories.title: Stellantis meeting ‘challenging’ but ‘productive’, Premier Ford says
stories.summary: The meeting came as Minister of Industry Mélanie Joly said the automaker can either keep its Brampton plant open or face a multimillion-dollar lawsuit from the federal government.

stories.title: Alleged Toronto faction of Italy-based mafia group sanctioned by U.S.
stories.summary: A Canadian faction of an alleged organized crime group founded in southern Italy has been sanctioned by the United States Treasury Department.

stories.title: Ontario, Ottawa committing $250M to help fund new port in Sault Ste. Marie
stories.summary: Ontario and the federal government say they're committing $250 million to help build a new port in Sault Ste. Marie on the north shore of the Saint Marys River.

stories.title: Kings’ Adrian Kempe fined for high-sticking Joshua
stories.summary: The NHL fined Los Angeles Kings forward Adrian Kempe US$3,500 Friday for high-sticking Toronto Maple Leafs forward Dakota Joshua.

stories.title: Ontario fugitive arrested in Winnipeg hours after making most wanted list
stories.summary: An Ontario fugitive wanted in connection with two Toronto-area shootings was arrested in Winnipeg Thursday, less than six hours after being placed on Canada’s most wanted list.

stories.title: Warning of credit rating downgrade ‘not a hinge moment’: Ontario finance minister
stories.summary: Ontario's Finance Minister is expressing confidence that the province will be able to avoid a credit rating downgrade amid "negative outlook" forcast

stories.title: Ontario Liberals to select third new leader since 2018
stories.summary: Ontario's Liberal Party will wrap up a long leadership race Saturday, and, they hope, an even longer stretch without a long-term leader.

stories.title: Toronto real estate brokerage registration suspended after buyers say deposits not returned
stories.summary: Ontario's real estate regulator has revoked the registrations of a Scarborough brokerage amid complaints involving roughly $500,000 in failed deals.
